title: A Hypergraph Based Approach to Declustering Problems
read_depth: Read sections2 definitions3-6 and section3 formulation/greedy refinement; institutional full PDF obtained.
evidence: Frequency-weighted expected maximum per-disk sum; item retrieval time explicitly may be a step function; capacity constraints. Atomic items are fixed, not matrix re-sharding. No native causal processing DAG.

title: Dependent Rounding and its Applications to Approximation Algorithms
read_depth: Read introduction P1-P3, section2.1 cycle/path rounding and degree/negative-correlation guarantees, Theorem2.3 and section3 concentration context. Author preprint obtained; not all applications read.
evidence: Binary bipartite edges, exact integer degree preservation at both endpoints, incident-edge negative correlation; directly yields balanced high-chip masks and query/chip concentration. Does not optimize arbitrary native causal latency.

title: Improved Bounds and Schemes for the Declustering Problem
read_depth: Read introduction and section2 formal positive multicolor discrepancy and theorem statements. Proofs and construction details not exhaustively checked.
evidence: Declustering is explicitly discrepancy over query hyperedges, with additive deviation from pooled work. Its proved bounds depend on geometrical range queries, so they must not be transplanted to arbitrary learned MoE route sets.

title: Parity Declustering for Continuous Operation in Redundant Disk Arrays
read_depth: Read abstract and sections4.1-4.3, including complete/BIBD subset construction, object/pair incidence and layout translation. Author PDF obtained; no simulator run.
evidence: k-of-v physical device subsets, single-stripe distinctness, device/pair incidence balance, complete/incomplete block-design families. Different RAID objective, not a direct solution of MoE causal mapping.
code_read_depth: Read author/copyright header, block-design parameters, LayoutTable/OffsetTable initialization, MapSector and IdentifyStripe. Raw source obtained; not built. CVS header version1.27 dated2023-09-25.

title: Cost Preserving Dependent Rounding for Allocation Problems
read_depth: Read abstract, introduction and Proposition1 support restriction. Did not validate full Theorem2 hypotheses for the coupled GU/down problem.
evidence: Even adding hard allocation cost alongside concentration has existing theory. Not asserted to solve this exact bipartite multicategory/native-DAG problem.

title: SMPyBandits DepRound implementation documentation
evidence: Runnable k-distinct-arms dependent-rounding API, but it is the star/one-vector case; it does not by itself maintain all chip column degrees. Not paper-author code and not a drop-in full balanced-mask solver.

title: ONFI Specification3.1 /4.0 multiple-LUN restrictions
read_depth: Official search-index excerpts of sections3.1.2-3.1.3 read. Direct opens were request-rejected; no full-spec read claimed.
evidence: Independent LUN progress, shared output bus, enhanced status/column command requirements. No compute-interface statement.

title: MQSim: A Framework for Enabling Realistic Studies of Modern Multi-Queue SSD Devices
read_depth: Read official repository README configuration:24 allocation schemes, out-of-order scheduling, independent die/plane counts. Not built in this round.
evidence: Public ordinary-SSD modeling controls; no native in-flash GEMV semantics.

title: Sprinkler: Maximizing Resource Utilization in Many-Chip Solid State Disks
read_depth: Read author PDF abstract/introduction and institutional bibliographic metadata only; no methods/full-paper read claimed.
evidence: Resource-layout-aware out-of-order scheduling and transaction locality are existing controller ideas, not placement novelty.
